[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [packages/cli/src/lib/umes/__tests__/collector.test.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/packages/cli/src/lib/umes/__tests__/collector.test.ts:23) resolves the source file with `path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'packages/cli/src/lib/umes/collector.ts')`. The package test entrypoint is [`jest --config jest.config.cjs`](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/packages/cli/package.json:48) and the Jest root is the CLI workspace itself ([jest.config.cjs](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/packages/cli/jest.config.cjs:6)), so normal package-level execution resolves that path under `packages/cli/packages/cli/...` and the new regression test fails before it exercises anything. This needs a path relative to the test file, not to `process.cwd()`.
- The branch does not satisfy the task’s required integration coverage. The diff only adds [collector.test.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/packages/cli/src/lib/umes/__tests__/collector.test.ts:1); nothing was added under the Playwright locations required by [.ai/qa/AGENTS.md](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/.ai/qa/AGENTS.md:53) and [.ai/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/.ai/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md:261). For CLI behavior consumed by standalone apps, the QA skill explicitly points to the parity path in [.ai/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/.ai/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md:203), and [packages/cli/AGENTS.md](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/targets/open-mercato/packages/cli/AGENTS.md:55) calls out that standalone discovery runs against compiled `dist/modules/*.js`, not source `.ts`. The current transpile-and-mock unit harness does not cover that real risk surface.

Validation note: I could not rerun the scoped CLI tests in this worktree because Yarn reports a missing install state (`findPackageLocation`), and there were no Playwright artifacts present in the branch.

That works only in the monorepo. The actual standalone parity flow runs this spec inside a generated app ([scripts/test-create-app-integration.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0088/scripts/test-create-app-integration.ts:110)), where `ROOT` is the scaffolded app root and there is no `packages/` tree. `fs.cpSync(...)` will throw `ENOENT` before any assertions run, so this branch regresses the required `yarn test:create-app:integration` coverage instead of adding it.

Scoped validation: `yarn --cwd packages/cli test --runInBand collector.test.ts` passes. I did not rerun the full standalone parity flow because the path mismatch above is deterministic from the code.
